summary.headline: Planetary Position Calculations
summary.text: Astrological calculations for determining the Sun’s zodiacal degree from Egyptian calendar dates, followed by procedures for locating Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars using elapsed years, months, days, cycles, and zodiacal release points. The apparatus discusses Egyptian month lengths and compares the calculations with observations attributed to Augustus’s first year, including Saturn in Cancer and Jupiter in Taurus and a reference to Ptolemy.
